jobs.description:
YMCA OF METROPOLITAN LOS ANGELES

The LA Y is the Center for Community Well-Being in Los Angeles, committed to building stronger communities by providing equitable programs and services to empower all. We are focused on fighting food insecurity, providing equity in education, making sure every child has the opportunity to experience the joy of sports, ensuring kids and teens have a safe place to grow, learn and live a healthy lifestyle. The LA Y’s health and wellness initiatives offer medical and mental health resources to ensure everyone has access to basic health needs. Our mission is to provide services and resources that contribute to the well-being of our community. The LA Y operates 29 Centers and over 200 program sites across LA County.

\*This position is grant funded, and continued employment is contingent upon the availability and renewal of funding and compliance with grant requirements. Positions may be modified or eliminated if funding is reduced, discontinued, or not renewed.\*

POSITION SUMMARY

* Connect community members impacted by HR1 policy changes and new community engagement requirements to YMCA volunteer opportunities where they can complete required hours and support continued benefit eligibility.
* Match individuals with appropriate YMCA volunteer opportunities based on required hours, location, availability, interests, and ability to participate.
* Guide community members through the volunteer placement process, including identifying opportunities, completing onboarding, and preparing to begin service.
* Work closely with Certified Enrollment Specialists (CES) to receive referrals and connect individuals who need volunteer hours to meet HR1 requirements with available YMCA placements.
* Maintain an up-to-date pipeline of YMCA volunteer opportunities that can support HR1 community engagement requirements, including schedules, capacity, locations, and available hours.
* Partner with YMCA centers to identify and develop volunteer opportunities and support registration, screening, background clearance, orientation, and onboarding.
* Maintain communication with centers regarding volunteer capacity, placements, scheduling, and barriers that may prevent individuals from completing required hours.
* Conduct proactive outreach through community events, resource fairs, schools, partner organizations, YMCA centers, and other trusted community spaces to reach populations impacted by HR1.
* Educate community members on HR1 policy changes, community engagement requirements, potential impacts, required actions, and available YMCA support.
* Stay informed of HR1 policy and implementation updates and share accurate, current information with YMCA centers, partners, and community members.
* Connect individuals to CES enrollment and renewal assistance and additional YMCA programs and resources as needed.
* Build relationships with community organizations and regional partners to strengthen HR1 outreach, referrals, and awareness of YMCA volunteer opportunities.
* Track volunteer referrals, placements, service hours, outreach activities, and other program data to support reporting and follow-up.
* Identify barriers, emerging community needs, and gaps in volunteer capacity and work with centers and program leadership to develop solutions.
* Funding Contingent Position: Continued employment is contingent upon the availability of program funding, ongoing program needs, and satisfactory job performance. Funding beyond the current funding period is not guaranteed.

YMCA LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES

The Y’s Leadership Competency Model is comprised of multiple leadership competencies (leadership knowledge, skills, and behaviors required for success in the Y), organized by the four disciplines of cause driven leadership:

* Advancing Our Mission & Cause: Provide visionary leadership to the organization and ensure that all resources are mobilized to adapt to new challenges and needs in the community.
  + Competencies Include: Change Leadership, Engaging Community, Philanthropy, & Volunteerism
* Building Relationships: Connect people to the Y’s cause by developing inclusive relationships, partnerships and collaborations so that Ys can co-create solutions to pressing social needs.
  + Competencies Include: Collaboration, Communication & Influence, Inclusion
* Leading Operations: ensure relevance, effectiveness, and sustainability of the organization so that we can continue to fulfill our promise to the community.
  + Competencies Include: Critical Thinking & Decision Making, Fiscal Management, Functional Expertise, Innovation, Program/Project Management
* Developing & Inspiring Others: support the holistic development of self and others so that everyone can embrace the Y’s cause, sustain the Y’s culture, and inspire others to take individual and collective action to further our impact.
  + Competencies Include: Developing Self & Others, Emotional Maturity

While all competencies are significant the following are critical to success in this position:

* Engaging Community: Builds relationships with YMCA centers, community members, and trusted community partners to expand outreach, connect individuals impacted by HR1 policy changes to volunteer opportunities, and increase access to YMCA resources and support.
* Volunteerism: Connects community members impacted by HR1 community engagement requirements to meaningful YMCA volunteer opportunities and supports them through the placement and onboarding process.

jobs.description:

Participation in our incentive programs (which may include eligible cash, equity, or commissions). jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Shoulder Sleeper makes recovery pillows and products for people healing from shoulder surgery. Our pillow is designed to be used alongside the sling from a patient's surgeon. We've helped more than 30,000 patients and work with more than 300 medical professionals. We're a small team in Orange County, so your work will be seen and felt every day.

Our customers are usually in pain, short on sleep, and a little overwhelmed. How we treat them matters as much as the product.

THE ROLE

You'll be the human voice of Shoulder Sleeper. You'll own our customer conversations on every channel, run our social media, and help build the brand. Your job is to make every customer feel looked after, whether that's a patient two days out of surgery or a clinic getting ready for its next patients. Most of all, you'll obsess over making every customer's experience better.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Customer experience

* Manage our phone line, support email, text messages, and website chat during office hours.

* Answer every customer kindly, clearly, and quickly.

* Help customers with orders, shipping, returns, and how to use their pillow.

* Follow up after purchase so customers feel supported through recovery.

* Go the extra mile: find unhappy customers online, reach out personally, and (with manager approval) send a replacement pillow or a handwritten note.

* Look at every step of the customer journey and find ways to make it easier.

* Track common questions and complaints, and turn them into fixes, FAQs, or new content.

* Log any customer reaction or side effect report and send it to leadership the same day.

* Keep clear notes, and share what customers are telling us with the team every week.

Community and social

* Run our Facebook group and keep it active, helpful, and positive.

* Reply to every comment on our ads and social posts.

* Find customers in the comments and turn them into conversations, reviews, and stories (with their permission).

* Plan, create, and schedule content across our social channels.

* Write captions, emails, and short videos that are helpful, kind, and on brand.

* Join the conversation in online recovery communities, like shoulder surgery support groups and patient forums.

* Reach out to medical and physical therapy pages, healthcare creators, and recovery accounts to get Shoulder Sleeper in front of their followers.

* Connect with larger practices and surgery centers that have an active social presence for features or collaborations.

* Track outreach and results so we know what's working.

* Send new content through our team's review process before it goes live.

Creative and marketing materials

* Create graphics in Canva, using AI tools to work faster.

* Order trifolds and other printed marketing materials for our clinics and for us, through our team's approval process.

* Help clinics and surgeon offices choose products and get the marketing materials they need.

GROWTH PATH

As you grow, you can take over our email marketing in Klaviyo, including campaigns, flows, and performance. Raises are tied to taking on that ownership.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must have

* A warm, patient communicator who likes helping people. Customer support or other customer-facing experience is a plus.

* Clear, warm writing. You can explain things simply to someone who is tired and hurting.

* Social media savvy, especially Facebook groups and ad comments, with experience creating content for a brand.

* Comfortable with Canva and everyday AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, AI image tools).

* A real drive to make customers' lives easier, and the habit of noticing what could be better.

* Organized and self-directed across several channels at once, with good follow-through on details.

* Able to work in person at our Irvine warehouse.

Nice to have

* Experience with Klaviyo or Shopify.

* Healthcare, physical therapy, or patient-facing experience.

* Experience at a small e-commerce or direct-to-consumer brand.

* Short-form video skills, including filming and editing on a phone.

* Experience with creator, influencer, or community outreach, especially in healthcare.

* Bilingual in English and Spanish.

PAY AND SCHEDULE

* Pay: $22 to $25 per hour, with raises as you take on more ownership.

* Schedule: Full-time, Monday to Friday during office hours. No weekends.

* Location: In person at our Irvine warehouse.

* Start date: As soon as possible.

HOW TO APPLY

Apply here with your resume and 2 or 3 examples of social content you've made (links are fine). In a few sentences, tell us about a time you turned an unhappy customer into a happy one.

Pay: $22.00 - $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Work Location: In person

**About us**
------------

Implicity is a digital MedTech company delivering advanced innovation to cardiologists through Big Data and Artificial Intelligence.  
  
Our industry-leading cardiac remote monitoring platform simplifies the management of complex clinical data and enables earlier identification of patient issues—helping clinicians deliver the right care at the right time.

More than a decade later, this French startup-turned-scale-up is helping shape the future of cardiology on a global scale.

* Over 250 hospitals and medical centers already use Implicity’s solutions
* Supporting more than 100,000 patients worldwide

* Patients receive higher-quality, more proactive care
* Physicians spend less time managing data and administrative burden, allowing greater focus on prevention and treatment
* Healthcare payers benefit from lower overall costs by emphasizing monitoring and prevention over hospitalization and acute intervention

  We’d love to connect.

**Job and recruitment context**
-------------------------------

**Position Summary**
--------------------

Our US clinical operations are growing as more of our practices move to full service. To keep pace and maintain the quality of service our customers expect, we are expanding our US Clinical Operations team.

The Clinical Operations Specialist owns the day-to-day processing of cardiac device transmissions for their assigned clinic sites, ensuring patients are monitored safely and efficiently. This role focuses on daily cardiac device alert triage, reading and reporting for US customers, adding capacity and coverage to the existing Clinical Operations team, and helping strengthen the processes that underpin our US remote monitoring service.

**Direct Report:** Krissy, Director of US Customer Experience

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Day-to-Day Clinical Operations**

* Perform daily triage of cardiac device alerts (CIED remote monitoring transmissions) using the Implicity platform.
* Review, interpret, and report on device data for implantable loop recorders, pacemakers, ICDs, and CRT devices.
* Ensure timely and accurate transmission processing in line with clinic protocols and physician requirements.
* Coordinate with clinic staff and physicians at your assigned clinic sites to resolve urgent findings.
* Maintain rigorous documentation standards and full compliance with HIPAA and PHI protocols.

**Platform and Workflow**

* Operate the Implicity remote monitoring platform as a primary clinical user at your assigned clinic sites.
* Support the onboarding of the Implicity platform within new clinic environments.
* Follow established SOPs and escalation protocols, and suggest improvements based on day-to-day practice.
* Help keep workflow documentation and quality checkpoints up to date.

**Team and Collaboration**

* Work alongside the Clinical Operations team to share coverage and best practices.
* Participate in recurring team meetings with Implicity’s US and France teams.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience in cardiac rhythm management and/or remote monitoring, including electrophysiology (EP) remote monitoring.
* Demonstrated experience in a CIED device clinic setting (loop recorders, pacemakers, ICDs, CRT devices).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to interface with both clinical and non-clinical stakeholders.
* Ability to operate independently and manage daily workload in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfortable working in a startup environment where processes are being built, not just followed.
* Rigorous adherence to HIPAA and PHI protocols; accurate clinical documentation across all communications.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Industry certification (CCDS, CEPS or CDRMS).
* EHR experience, particularly Epic.
* Prior exposure to SaaS-based health tech tools or digital health platforms.
* Cross-cultural communication experience (our HQ and a significant part of the team are based in Paris, France).
* Experience working within or alongside a geographically distributed, international team.

**What We Look For**

* Integrity and patient-first mindset: you take accuracy in device monitoring seriously.
* Collaborative spirit: you work well with colleagues, physicians, and a geographically distributed team.
* Ambition and growth mindset: you want to help build and scale a growing US Clinical Operations function.

**Physical Requirements**

* Prolonged periods of sitting and computer use.
* Frequent use of telephone and headset equipment.
* Ability to work standard business hours with occasional schedule flexibility as needed.

  **2°** Clinical interview with our Clinical Operations team, including a clinical / technical test

jobs.description:
**ABOUT GREYSTAR**

Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit www.greystar.com.

**JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY**

The Community Manager is responsible for overseeing the ongoing operations, performance, and resident experience of an established multifamily or Active Adult community. This role provides leadership and direction to on-site team members while ensuring operational efficiency, financial performance, and a high standard of customer service.  
With a strong focus on resident satisfaction, team development, and community culture, the Community Manager maintains full compliance with Greystar policies and applicable federal, state, and local laws—including Fair Housing, ADA, and FCRA. This position plays a pivotal role in sustaining long-term community success through proactive management, strategic planning, and consistent delivery of an exceptional living environment tailored to the needs of current and future residents.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

* Responds promptly to resident concerns, complaints, questions, and requests, and takes appropriate action to resolve and address issues. Handles escalated resident disputes with empathy and problem-solving.
* Completes various required accounting, financial, administrative, operational, and other reports, and performs other duties as assigned or as necessary, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
* Serves as the liaison with ownership, investors, and regional/asset management teams. Leads ownership/partner site visits, providing performance updates, market insights, and suggestions to improve overall performance and financial success of the property. Provides recommendations for long-term asset preservation, revenue growth, and expense control strategies.
* Oversees hiring, onboarding, and training, and manages performance and professional development of team members in accordance with Company policies, values, and business practices. Ensures team members are current on all required trainings and certifications, and any/all performance issues are appropriately and promptly addressed.
* Oversees the lease enforcement process by making periodic apartment inspections, following proper notice requirements, evicting residents, and imposing and collecting late fees and other charges as allowable and stated in the terms of the lease. Enforces community rules and lease policies to maintain a safe and orderly environment. Coordinates with legal counsel for evictions, lease disputes, and compliance matters.
* Conducts interactive Daily Huddles, regular one-on-one coaching/check-ins, and annual reviews. Meets regularly with team members to understand and assist in completion of their required responsibilities and annual goal setting. Keeps them informed of resident situations as necessary. Shares team and community goals and engages them to understand their role in helping the team in accomplishing them.
* Supervises sales activities to achieve the community’s revenue and occupancy goals. Monitors leasing team performance and metrics (closing ratios, lead conversion, traffic sources, and lead management). Conduct community tours as needed and ensure model and vacant units are in good standing and tour ready.
* Meets targeted revenues by setting rent rates, ensuring rent and fees are collected and posted in a timely manner, making financial bank deposits, and preparing and reviewing monthly financial status reports. Oversees accounts payable/receivable, invoice approvals, and vendor billing accuracy. Develops and executes strategies to drive NOI (net operating income) through rent growth, ancillary income opportunities, and expense control.
* Conducts regular community inspections and takes appropriate actions to maintain safety, cleanliness, curb appeal, ensure preventative maintenance schedules are executed and that amenities are fully operational.
* Promotes resident satisfaction and retention by building a strong community culture while monitoring and responding to resident satisfaction surveys and online reviews in order to maintain strong reputation management.
* Oversees budget creation, forecasting, and monthly variance reporting. Prepares and presents financial performance updates to ownership/asset managers.
* Maintains confidentiality of pertinent personal information concerning residents and staff.
* Analyzes, and interprets local market and economic trends that may impact the community, understands the competitive market set and implements short- and long-range marketing and leasing strategies to achieve the community’s occupancy and revenue goals, and adjust pricing and marketing strategies.
* Directs and supports maintenance/service operations, ensuring timely work order completion and preventive maintenance programs.

**About Inaba Foods (USA) Inc.**  
Inaba Foods is a manufacturer of premium pet food, treats, toppers, and complements, deeply rooted in a family tradition of excellence that spans generations. Since 1958, pet parents have trusted Inaba to deliver products that are human-grade, nutrient-rich, and designed to bring joy to pets.

This is a full-time, in-office position based in Oak Brook, IL, as required by company leadership.

* Grow distribution and sales volume within assigned Pet Specialty accounts
